statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient is being evaluated for potential arrhythmias
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229, is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
